hero.kicker: Ceramic coating in Sterling Heights, MI
hero.title: Salt season is long. **Coat it once.**
hero.lede: A ceramic coating puts a hard, bonded layer between your paint and a Michigan winter of road salt and brine. Our 1, 3 and 5 year packages include paint correction and a written warranty, and the shop is about 7 miles from central Sterling Heights.

local.title: Why Sterling Heights paint needs more than wax.
local.intro: Salt on the state routes and on your own street, sap from the street trees, and one automatic wash after another to keep up with both. That combination dulls clear coat faster than most owners expect. A coating changes how all of it sticks.

points.title: Salt does not get a grip
points.body: State and primary roads get plowed and salted first, which here includes Van Dyke (M-53) and Hall Road (M-59). The city salts its own streets too. On bare clear coat that film works on the paint all winter. On a coated panel it comes off with a rinse and a gentle hand wash, so you can skip the brush tunnels that put swirl marks in the finish.

points.title: Street trees over the driveway
points.body: Sterling Heights has been a Tree City USA for decades, and the city says its goal is a street tree in front of every home. That means sap and bird droppings on whatever is parked underneath. On a coated panel they wipe off before they etch the paint.

points.title: For trucks you plan to keep
points.body: The Ram 1500 is built in Sterling Heights, at the assembly plant on Van Dyke. If yours was bought to keep, look at The Revival and The Renewal, our 3 and 5 year packages. They are meant for exactly that owner.

points.title: Glass in the same visit
points.body: Coat the windshield and exterior glass at the same appointment and rain sheets off at highway speed. You notice it the first wet morning on the Van Dyke Freeway.

logistics.title: Coating happens at the shop. Getting there is easy.
body: Ceramic coating is done indoors at our Clinton Township shop, where the lighting, temperature and cure time are under our control. From central Sterling Heights the shop is about 7 miles, roughly 15 minutes without traffic, and the simple way over is Utica Road southeast to 14 Mile Road, then east to just past Kelly Road.

Plan on leaving the vehicle with us for at least a full day. Uber is covered for the drop-off and pickup, or ask about [pick-up and drop-off valet](/mobile-detailing/): we collect the vehicle from your home or work in Sterling Heights and bring it back coated.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Our shop, 33115 Louise Ave, Clinton Township

faq.q: Can you apply a ceramic coating at my home in Sterling Heights?
faq.a: No, and you would not want us to. A coating has to go on in a controlled space, out of the wind, dust and sun, and then cure before the vehicle goes back outside. We do that at the shop. If the drive is the obstacle, valet pickup brings the vehicle to us and back to you.

faq.q: How long will you have my vehicle?
faq.a: Plan on at least a full day, and longer when the paint needs more correction. The decontamination, paint correction and cure time are what take the hours. We give you an exact window when we quote your vehicle.

faq.q: How much does ceramic coating cost for a truck?
faq.a: Coating is quoted per vehicle, because size and paint condition decide the work. A full size truck has more surface than a sedan and often more correction to do first. Tell us what you drive and we will give you a real number, usually in the same conversation. [Request a free quote](#quote).

faq.q: Is a coating worth it on a leased vehicle?
faq.a: Often, yes. The Refresh, our 1 year package, is built for leased vehicles and cars you will trade in soon. It gives you a year of protection and easier washing without paying for years you will not use. See [all three coating packages](/ceramic-coating/).
